purpose: Research artifact only. Curated Framer Marketplace reference candidates for the 24 existing Site Örnekleri designs (prisma/catalog-seed-data.ts is the source of truth for sectors/designs). Not wired into src/lib/design-preview-config.ts yet — pending approval.

methodology.discovery: 8 parallel research agents (one per sector, general-purpose, WebSearch/WebFetch only) searched Framer Marketplace and community showcases for 5-8 candidates per design.
methodology.verification: All 136 unique candidate demo URLs were centrally verified with tests/verify-frameable.mjs (npm run verify:frame): real Playwright cross-origin iframe render using the same sandbox flags as production, plus header checks (X-Frame-Options, CSP frame-ancestors, WAF/challenge headers).
methodology.scoring: Visual quality 25%, Sector relevance 20%, Iframe reliability 20%, Mobile quality 10%, Desktop quality 10%, Distinctiveness 10%, Client presentation value 5%. Visual/desktop scores informed by --shots screenshots and real render metrics (chars/elements/images loaded), not agent text descriptions alone -- two agent-reported 'dark theme' claims (Skins for GUZ-03, Constructionn for MIM-03) were caught and rejected on screenshot inspection as actually light-themed.

rejectedCandidatesSummary: Full per-design candidate lists (5-8 per design, ~136 total unique URLs) with individual rejection reasons are preserved in docs/framer-reference-research.md under each sector's 'Other candidates considered' section. Two notable rejections caught only via screenshot review after initially scoring well on text/metrics: Skins (GUZ-03, claimed dark, actually light pink/peach) and Constructionn (MIM-03, claimed dark, actually light cream/beige).
